full_judgment: Muhammad Imman Ali J.:- This appeal, by leave, is directed against the judgment and order dated 08.06.1997 passed by a single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 660 of 1995 making the Rule absolute and sending the case back on remand to the trial Court for fresh trial on taking fresh evidence and thereby setting aside the judgment and order dated 28.11.1992 passed by the Additional District Judge, First Court, Sylhet in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 161 of 1985 dismissing the miscellaneous appeal and affirming the judgment and order dated 25.11.1985 passed by the Munsif, First Court (Assistant Judge) Sadar, Sylhet in Miscellaneous Case No. 97 of 1980 allowing the prayer for preemption which was sought under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950.
